import Mathlib
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Herstein_exercise_2_5_23 {G : Type*} [Group G]
  (hG : ∀ (H : Subgroup G), H.Normal) (a b : G) :
  ∃ (j : ℤ) , b*a = a^j * b := by
  have hN : Subgroup.Normal (Subgroup.zpowers a) := hG (Subgroup.zpowers a)
  have ha : a ∈ Subgroup.zpowers a := Subgroup.mem_zpowers a
  
  have hconj : b * a * b⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.zpowers a := hN.conj_mem a ha b
  rw [Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff] at hconj
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hconj
  
  have hj_eq : b * a * b⁻¹ = a ^ j := by
    first | exact hj | exact hj.symm
  exact ⟨j, by calc b * a = b * a * b⁻¹ * b := by group
                  _ = a ^ j * b := by rw [hj_eq]⟩
